items.name: Boundedness
items.summary: Represents whether a stream of data **generated** by an operator is bounded (finite) or unbounded (infinite).

items.summary: Represents how an operator emits its output records.

items.name: SchedulingType

items.name: ExecutionPlan
items.signature: trait ExecutionPlan: Any + Debug + DisplayAs + Send + Sync
items.summary: Represent nodes in the DataFusion Physical Plan.

methods.name: apply_expressions
methods.signature: fn apply_expressions(&self, f: &mut dyn FnMut(&Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>) -> Result<TreeNodeRecursion>) -> Result<TreeNodeRecursion>
methods.summary: Apply a closure `f` to each root expression that this node owns and uses during execution, either by evaluating it or updating it dynamically.

methods.name: benefits_from_input_partitioning
methods.summary: Specifies whether the `ExecutionPlan` benefits from increased parallelization at its input for each child.

methods.name: cardinality_effect
methods.summary: Gets the effect on cardinality, if known

methods.name: check_invariants
methods.summary: Returns an error if this individual node does not conform to its invariants. These invariants are typically only checked in debug mode.

methods.name: child_stats_requests
methods.summary: Returns, per child, which statistics the [`StatisticsContext`] should resolve before calling [`Self::statistics_from_inputs`].

methods.name: children
methods.summary: Get a list of children `ExecutionPlan`s that act as inputs to this plan. The returned list will be empty for leaf nodes such as scans, will contain a single value for unary nodes, or two values for binary nodes (such as joins).

methods.name: downcast_delegate
methods.summary: Returns the plan that provides this plan's public [`ExecutionPlan`] downcast identity.

methods.name: dynamic_expressions_produced
methods.summary: Returns the dynamic expressions produced by this plan node.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: fn execute(&self, partition: usize, context: Arc<TaskContext>) -> Result<SendableRecordBatchStream>
methods.summary: Begin execution of `partition`, returning a [`Stream`] of [`RecordBatch`]es.

methods.name: fetch
methods.summary: Gets the fetch count for the operator, `None` means there is no fetch.

methods.name: gather_filters_for_pushdown
methods.signature: fn gather_filters_for_pushdown(&self, _phase: FilterPushdownPhase, parent_filters: Vec<Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>>, _config: &ConfigOptions) -> Result<FilterDescription>
methods.summary: Collect filters that this node can push down to its children. Filters that are being pushed down from parents are passed in, and the node may generate additional filters to push down. For example, given the plan FilterExec -> HashJoinExec…

methods.name: handle_child_pushdown_result
methods.signature: fn handle_child_pushdown_result(&self, _phase: FilterPushdownPhase, child_pushdown_result: ChildPushdownResult, _config: &ConfigOptions) -> Result<FilterPushdownPropagation<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>>
methods.summary: Handle the result of a child pushdown.

methods.name: input_distribution_requirements
methods.summary: Specifies the input distribution requirements for this plan.

methods.name: maintains_input_order
methods.summary: Returns `false` if this `ExecutionPlan`'s implementation may reorder rows within or between partitions.

methods.name: metrics
methods.summary: Return a snapshot of the set of [`Metric`]s for this [`ExecutionPlan`]. If no `Metric`s are available, return None.

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Short name for the ExecutionPlan, such as 'DataSourceExec'.

methods.name: partition_statistics
methods.summary: Returns statistics for a specific partition of this `ExecutionPlan` node.

methods.name: properties
methods.summary: Return properties of the output of the `ExecutionPlan`, such as output ordering(s), partitioning information etc.

methods.name: repartitioned
methods.summary: If supported, attempt to increase the partitioning of this `ExecutionPlan` to produce `target_partitions` partitions.

methods.name: replace_children
methods.signature: fn replace_children(Arc<self>, children: Vec<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>, options: ReplaceChildrenOptions) -> Result<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>
methods.summary: Returns a clone of the existing plan with the children replaced, skipping recomputation of plan properties when the options indicate the new children's properties are unchanged.

methods.name: required_input_distribution
methods.summary: Specifies simple per-child input distribution requirements.

methods.name: required_input_ordering
methods.summary: Specifies the ordering required for all of the children of this `ExecutionPlan`.

methods.name: reset_state
methods.summary: Reset any internal state within this [`ExecutionPlan`].

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Get the schema for this execution plan

methods.name: static_name
methods.signature: fn static_name() -> &'static str where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Short name for the ExecutionPlan, such as 'DataSourceExec'. Like [`name`](ExecutionPlan::name) but can be called without an instance.

methods.name: statistics_from_inputs
methods.summary: Returns statistics for a specific partition of this `ExecutionPlan` node, given pre-computed child statistics.

methods.name: supports_limit_pushdown
methods.summary: Returns `true` if a limit can be safely pushed down through this `ExecutionPlan` node.

methods.name: try_pushdown_sort
methods.summary: Try to push down sort ordering requirements to this node.

methods.name: try_swapping_with_projection
methods.summary: Attempts to push down the given projection into the input of this `ExecutionPlan`.

methods.name: try_to_proto
methods.summary: Serialize this plan to its protobuf representation, if it knows how.

methods.name: with_fetch
methods.summary: Returns a fetching variant of this `ExecutionPlan` node, if it supports fetch limits. Returns `None` otherwise.

methods.name: with_new_children
methods.signature: fn with_new_children(Arc<self>, children: Vec<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>) -> Result<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>
methods.summary: Deprecated.

methods.name: with_new_children_and_same_properties
methods.signature: fn with_new_children_and_same_properties(Arc<self>, children: Vec<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>) -> Result<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>
methods.summary: Deprecated. Implement [`ExecutionPlan::replace_children`] instead.

methods.name: with_new_state
methods.signature: fn with_new_state(&self, _state: Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>) -> Option<Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>>
methods.summary: Injects arbitrary run-time state into this execution plan, returning a new plan instance that incorporates that state *if* it is relevant to the concrete node implementation.

methods.name: with_preserve_order
methods.summary: Returns a variant of this `ExecutionPlan` that is aware of order-sensitivity.

items.name: ExecutionPlanProperties
items.summary: Extension trait provides an easy API to fetch various properties of [`ExecutionPlan`] objects based on [`ExecutionPlan::properties`].

methods.name: boundedness
methods.summary: Boundedness information of the stream corresponding to this `ExecutionPlan`. For more details, see [`Boundedness`].

methods.name: equivalence_properties
methods.summary: Get the [`EquivalenceProperties`] within the plan.

methods.name: output_ordering
methods.summary: If the output of this `ExecutionPlan` within each partition is sorted, returns `Some(keys)` describing the ordering. A `None` return value indicates no assumptions should be made on the output ordering.

methods.name: output_partitioning
methods.summary: Specifies how the output of this `ExecutionPlan` is split into partitions.

methods.name: pipeline_behavior
methods.summary: Indicates how the stream of this `ExecutionPlan` emits its results. For more details, see [`EmissionType`].
